identity.cards: JSkat Card enum names are suit C/S/H/D plus rank A/T/K/Q/J/9/8/7, matching V2 two-character tokens; require 32-card bijection test
identity.game_id: Stable host table plus local game identity, never card or wall-clock-derived only
identity.seats: JSkat Player FOREHAND/MIDDLEHAND/REARHAND getOrder() 0/1/2 equals V2 seat integer; verify turn rotation at integration
identity.sequence_no: Monotone per game at each requested decision; validate response request_id and position_hash before acting
identity.source_context: Only provenance and public host metadata; never hidden game state

phase_mapping.gap: nextBidValue must map exactly to V2 bid_index from same auction schedule
phase_mapping.mapping: BIDDER CONTINUE returns exactly nextBidValue; PASS returns 0; do not invent or skip bid values
phase_mapping.required_inputs: 10 own cards, actor, bidder, answerer, bid_index; host must track bidding sequence

phase_mapping.mapping: ANSWERER CONTINUE returns true; PASS returns false
phase_mapping.required_inputs: 10 own cards, actor, bidder, answerer, bid_index

phase_mapping.gap: V2 declaration action is a contract, not a pickup decision; post-pickup observation expects 12 cards. Do not infer choice from hidden skat or hard-code it as complete integration.
phase_mapping.mapping: Requires a declared phase protocol for hand-versus-pickup choice

phase_mapping.gap: Verify JSkat callback ordering and whether the player internal knowledge still has all 12 cards
phase_mapping.mapping: V2 unordered pair action in observation hand12 order -> JSkat two Card values
phase_mapping.required_inputs: 12 own cards after pickup, seat, winning bid

phase_mapping.gap: Confirm engine order. If announceGame follows discard, original 12-card decision observation must be retained immutably with exact game identity; no post-hoc restoration using host hidden state.
phase_mapping.mapping: Map reviewed legal contract set and V2 action to JSkat GameContract
phase_mapping.required_inputs: 10 cards for hand or 12 cards for pickup per V2 observation; JSkat may already have discarded to 10

phase_mapping.gap: Replay full public sequence; track own discarded skat privately only for declarer and public ouvert cards only when actually shown.
phase_mapping.mapping: JSkat own hand, seat, declarer, contract, public trick/history, validated legal cards -> V2; selected card must remain JSkat legal
phase_mapping.required_inputs: own cards and lawfully disclosed game history only

phase_mapping.gap: Never silently claim full JSkat variant support from four V2 phases.
phase_mapping.mapping: Explicit mode limitation or versioned stable API extension required

public_information_policy.allowed: Own hand, public auction, announced contract/declarer, public cards/tricks, legally disclosed ouvert hand, own picked-up/discarded skat when actor is declarer
public_information_policy.prohibited: Whole JSkat game state, opponent private hands, unopened skat for defenders, uncertain possible-card estimates as if observations, future tricks, private host test labels
public_information_policy.special: JSkat ImmutablePlayerKnowledge.getSkat and getDeclarerPlayerCards are conditional; permit only after lawful revelation to this seat. Recompute and compare legal card set against independent V2 rules before requesting play.

required_validation: Exact JSkat callback order and information timing across pickup/hand/announce/discard, with an independently reproduced local game
32-card and contract bijection, with flags hand/Schneider/Schwarz/ouvert/Null
Legal action and scoring parity on independently generated edge cases
No hidden-state leakage from JSkat knowledge/game objects
Headless four-phase end-to-end adapter smoke, late/duplicate/stale response rejection and release swap
Windows 11 packaged app runtime/GUI responsiveness and distributable asset rights

runtime_policy.boundary: One persistent V2 host service loaded from an accepted release package; adapter is a game host, not AI implementation
runtime_policy.effect_rule: Validate response schema, request_id, position_hash, sequence_no, release_id and exact legal action before JSkat callback returns
runtime_policy.thread_rule: Java UI thread must not synchronously wait on Python inference; no mutable per-game state shared across simultaneous games
runtime_policy.timeout_rule: Deadline measured per callback; errors/late responses fail closed at the host integration gate; fallback behavior must be explicitly decided and measured before release
